tool_args.rationale: The five fixed-gradient points rise and flatten with input, while the acquired open-branch pair shows markedly lower output at high sink gradient. Fit the bridge-mapped two-layer siphon with positive square-root branch numerically to all seven rows; the probe resolved the relevant branch ambiguity, so no further measurement is justified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its low- versus high-gradient readings establish a strong sink effect and favor the positive square-root branch.
All observations share H, x_now, and memory state; the bridge signatures and saturating input response support the static bridge-mapped siphon, not a trajectory-dependent ODE.
Its extra barrier parameter is not motivated by the smooth saturating input response and would add complexity without a discriminating observation.
